input-field.name: sitemapRefreshTime
input-field.label: Refresh interval
刷新间隔
input-field.helpText: Enter interval in seconds. (Active only in live mode.)
请输入间隔的秒数。（仅在实时模式下生效。）

input-field.name: sitemapRefreshStrategy
input-field.label: Refresh strategy
刷新方式
input-field.helpText:
Manually: refresh via console command: php bin/console sitemap:generate.
Scheduled: refresh via scheduled tasks (every 24 hours).
Live: Refresh in intervals defined above, if Administration is opened.

手动：通过控制台命令刷新：php bin/console sitemap:generate。
定时：通过计划任务刷新（每 24 小时）。
实时：打开后台时，按上方设定的间隔刷新。

input-field.name: excludeLinkedProducts
input-field.label: Exclude hidden products from sitemap
从站点地图中排除隐藏商品
input-field.helpText: Products, that are hidden in listings and search, will be excluded from the sitemap
在列表和搜索中被隐藏的商品，将从站点地图中排除
